research_note: Identification: no Pakistani project actually named 'Lakefront Towers' (or 'Lake Front Tower(s)') was found. Lakeshore Towers is the closest match by name and is literally a lakefront tower project, so it is most likely the one meant (moderate confidence, about 60–70%). Other lakeside candidates: Crescent Lake Tower and Grand Millennium (both Bahria Town Phase 8, lake view) and Lake Vista Heights (Bahria Town Phase 8, ZEM Builders). Facts: land area is 16.7 kanal on the official counter, 16.5 kanal in the official FAQ and about 16.16 kanal (9,779 sq yd) per Manahil Estate. In-house commercial area is over 100,000 sq ft in the official FAQ but about 50,000 sq ft per Manahil Estate. Unit sizes differ between the official site ('from' sizes used here) and Manahil Estate (e.g. Twin Loft 5,584 sq ft). The renders show several tower blocks on a shared podium, but the number of towers is not stated. Approvals: NOCs from RDA, CAA, EPA and Punjab Emergency Service (1122); registered under the PM's construction amnesty scheme. The official site posts video progress updates, the latest dated 06-11-25; APP described it as under construction (article dated 17 Jan, year not shown, probably 2026). Completion date and prices are not published. Top City-1 is marketed as Islamabad, but OSM places it in Rawalpindi tehsil near the M-2 toll plaza. Both images are official renders; no real construction photo with a clear licence was found. City set to Rawalpindi to match the portal's Top City-1 record and OpenStreetMap; the developer markets it as Islamabad.
